executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-19 reviewed eight relevant reports; it does not indicate any confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields could relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
